## Analysis

`sol_0012` is the strongest new result, showing that structured high-cardinality tensor supports outperform all local searches around the 17-point incumbent, though they still trail `sol_0001` overall. The affine-copy hypothesis remains completely untested: `sol_0014` crashed before enumeration because its alleged incumbent was actually `sol_0000`. This reinforces that descriptions and hard-coded metric assertions are unsafe; every fallback must be scored directly and written before search begins.
